test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
By folding the given paper, which of the following box can be made?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/276476d37754c6c42cd320cbb571ca6f2a8bac4192100d9b1dbc564239b06174.png]
solution:
Faces opposite to each other is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56a17637a08feae76faf9d6fc70f236582f0d9f0460d4d4a24951ae9f3a93cd9.png] 

 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 
4

 
 
 
6

 
 
 

 
 
C

 
 
 
3

 
 
 
2

 
 
 

1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d0ee89278c6124e7ffadfa2fe926c9ba7b06f0b1ad80af7c7d5676a0a8aef9e.png] → Cannot be formed (As, 6 and 2 are opposite faces. So, they cannot appear at the same time on the dice)

2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cad97487aad46f2299e15acceadc5f4d40e9243faa84db7109234b1e08e4c908.png] → Cannot be formed (As, 4 and 3 are opposite faces. So, they cannot appear at the same time on the dice)

3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/414c71391ae91195221750412724e8abb86a12917ba7b16ceb7979136668d55b.png] → Can be formed.

4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86f07fd1e764229fb7d988495bc565a8cc96e61703387999a0decdedf23ca72d.png] → Cannot be formed (As, A and C are opposite faces. So, they cannot appear at the same time on the dice)

Hence, '**option 3**' is the correct answer.
